text:
Adverse event summary for the reported quality records includes central line-associated bloodstream infection and sepsis bundle compliance measures for 2026-Q1.

For measure CLABSI-01, “Central line-associated bloodstream infection rate,” the reported unit is per 1,000 line-days. The record reports a numerator of 63, a denominator of 887, exclusions of 37, and a rate of 74.12 per 1,000 line-days. The event dates recorded for this measure are 2026-01-26, 2026-04-14, 2026-06-26, 2026-08-07, and 2026-11-02. These dates are presented as listed in the source record.

For measure SEP-B1, “Sepsis bundle compliance within 3 hours,” the reported unit is percent. The record reports a numerator of 115, a denominator of 535, exclusions of 41, and a rate of 23.28 percent. The event dates recorded for this measure are 2026-02-14, 2026-04-08, 2026-08-18, 2026-09-28, and 2026-10-19. These dates are presented as listed in the source record.

Across the reported 2026-Q1 records, CLABSI-01 is expressed as an infection rate per 1,000 line-days, while SEP-B1 is expressed as a compliance percentage. The records include numerator, denominator, exclusions, rate, period, unit, measure name, measure identifier, and event dates for each measure. No additional causal factors, patient-level details, facility locations, severity classifications, preventability determinations, or outcome descriptions are provided in the source records. Therefore, this summary is limited to the reported measure values and listed event dates.
